name: English Shepherd's Pie
description: A traditional shepherd's pie with ground beef, vegetables, and mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef briskly over high heat. Drain off excess fat.
Add the chopped onion and reduce heat. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the meat is well browned.
Sprinkle the flour over the meat mixture and stir to coat evenly.
Gradually add water, stock cube, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, bay leaf, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Add the can of peas to the meat mixture.
Transfer the meat mixture to a casserole dish and cover with mashed potatoes.
Bake in a 400°F oven until the top is golden brown.

keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes

_similar.name: Shepherd's Pie
_similar.description: A classic shepherd's pie made with ground beef, mixed vegetables, and topped with mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef in an electric skillet. Drain excess fat.
Add onion soup mix, frozen vegetables, beef cube, salt, and pepper. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes.
Pour the mixture into a 6-cup (1.5 L) casserole dish or square baking dish.
Top with mashed potatoes and sprinkle with paprika if desired.
Bake at 400°F for 15 to 20 minutes, until the potatoes are firm and golden brown.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes, casserole

_similar.name: Hamburger Pie
_similar.description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Hawaiian Meatballs
_similar.description: A Hawaiian-inspired meatball recipe with a sweet and sour sauce, cooked in a pan and finished in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the meat mixture together and shape into balls.
Dredge the meatballs in flour and brown in shortening on both sides.
Remove the meatballs from the pan and set aside.
Mix the dry sauce ingredients well, then stir in the wet ingredients.
Stir the sauce mixture into the fat in the pan and cook until thick and bubbly.
Return the meatballs to the pan, cover, and put in the oven to cook for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: Hawaiian meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, oven-finished

_similar.name: Swedish Meatballs
_similar.description: Classic Swedish meatballs made with ground beef, served in a rich gravy, and optionally served with rice, potatoes, or pasta.
recipeIngredient: Cooking oil or fat for frying

recipeInstructions.text: Combine beef, bread crumbs, milk, eggs, onions, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Mix really well.
Shape mixture into 1-inch balls.
Heat fat in a skillet over medium heat. Cook meatballs, turning with a spoon until browned.
Remove cooked meatballs with a slotted spoon and place in a bowl. Repeat until all meatballs are cooked, adding more fat as needed.
Pour hot water into the skillet and stir to loosen browned particles.
Blend flour and cold water, then stir into the skillet. Cook until the gravy thickens.
Pour gravy over meatballs and cook for about 25 minutes.
Serve with rice, potatoes, or pasta.

_similar.name: Meat Balls and Sour And Sweet Sauce
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe served in a tangy sweet and sour sauce, perfect for serving over meatballs, chicken, or pork chops.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp onion flakes or 1 tsp real onion

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together and form into 1½ inch balls.
Bake in an ungreased oblong pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°F.
Remove from oven and drain grease.
Place meatballs in a large casserole.
Pour sweet and sour sauce over the top and return to oven for 10 minutes or until hot.
To make the sauce, mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and stir while bringing to a boil until thickened.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, baked meatballs
